function.name: set_ac_state
function.description: Set the state of the air conditioner by adjusting the temperature, mode, fan speed, and fan position to achieve the desired comfort level. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temperature.description: Desired temperature setting for the air conditioner in degrees Celsius.

fan_speed.description: Fan speed level from 1 to 5, where 1 is the lowest speed and 5 is the highest.

fan_position.description: Fan position level from 1 to 5, where 1 is the lowest and 5 is the highest.

function.name: get_ac_state
function.description: Fetch the current operational state of the air conditioner, including mode, temperature settings, and power status. If 'unit_id' is not provided, the default air conditioner unit will be queried. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

unit_id.description: The unique identifier of the air conditioner unit. If omitted, the system will fetch the state of the default AC unit.

include_diagnostics.description: Whether to include diagnostic information in the response.

I’m a conversational AI that can help you with a wide range of tasks, from answering questions and providing explanations to assisting with everyday chores. Here’s a quick rundown of what I can do:

| Category | What I can help with |
|----------|----------------------|
| **General Knowledge** | Explain concepts, give summaries, provide historical facts, science, math, etc. |
| **Practical Advice** | Offer cooking tips, travel recommendations, DIY guidance, health & wellness suggestions (non‑medical). |
| **Entertainment** | Tell jokes, share trivia, recommend books/movies/TV shows, play text‑based games. |
| **Productivity** | Draft emails, create outlines, help with planning, set reminders (via integration), manage to‑do lists. |
| **Technical Help** | Explain code snippets, debug simple issues, give programming advice. |
| **Smart Home Control** | **Control your air conditioner** – I can set temperature, mode, fan speed, and fan position using the built‑in `set_ac_state` function. I can also fetch the current AC state with `get_ac_state`. |
| **Conversational Companion** | Chat about hobbies, interests, or just keep you company. |

If you want to try controlling your AC right now, just let me know the desired temperature, mode, fan speed, and fan position, and I’ll call the function for you. Otherwise, feel free to ask anything else!
